hero.title: Reaching the right person beats reaching the right form
hero.description: We split contact by what you actually need. Already using the product, or evaluating it? Take the support line. Want to bring your own industry capability onto Ruyin? Take the ecosystem line. Pick the wrong one and we will simply pass you to the right colleague.
